messages:
alex: heads up — acct has a hard no-egress requirement for the POC. they want zero outbound during runtime and only offline bundle installs. asking what our realistic upgrade cadence & costs look like.

maria: ok noted. are they expecting monthly security patches or just quarterly feature deltas?

alex: security patches asap but only via signed delta bundles delivered on USB or SFTP pull (they'll import). they asked for a rollback plan and customer-managed KMS/HSM.

jamie: we can do signed deltas + detached signing key (HSM supported). main tradeoffs: size of delta bundles vs. engineering ops to support one-off installs. pricing uplift for airgap support.

sophie: devinfra here — technically feasible. constraints: 1) bundle must be reproducible (we sign manifest) 2) upgrade window needs operator access to node via jumpbox (we can doc a zero-ssh flow but ops will need console access) 3) KV-cache warmup on first boot => cold-start slowness.

alex: customer also wants a 2-week rollback SLA after each bundle. is that doable?

jamie: 2 weeks is fine for patch retention, but we need to clarify what rollback means (image revert vs. DB migration revert). if we ship migrations, rollbacks get tricky.

maria: commercial note — add a per-POC service line for on-site or USB bundle work and an elevated ticket SLA. typically +20-35% on top of hosting committed price for sealed/offline handling.

legal_john: we'll need a short security addendum: attestations for no-call-home, proof of bundle signing chain, and customer KMS integration terms. I can draft a 1-pager.

alex: customer wants to avoid ongoing agent telemetry. they asked whether our runtime can operate with telemetry disabled and still get supported.

sophie: support with telemetry disabled = possible but limited diagnostics. require retained logs on their side and periodic runbooks. we can provide a supported 'silent mode' build and a support SKU for remote debug when they enable egress.

jamie: example bundle manifest we usually hand off:
```
name: redwood-poc-bundle
version: 2023-11-14-rc1
components:
  - runtime: redwood-runtime-2.3.qz
  - model: llama-13b-8bit.qnt
  - signature: sha256:abc123...
```

alex: perfect. can you also outline approximate cost/time for building monthly signed deltas vs quarterly monolithic bundles? customer will debate logistics.

maria: quick estimate: monthly signed deltas = +3 engineer-days/mo for packaging + $X per bundle handling (labour/media), quarterly monolith = +1 eng-day/mo average, lower ops overhead but bigger upgrade windows. will formalize numbers in SOW.

sophie: ops note: if they insist on USB-only channels, include checksum verification and offline integrity test in runbook. we recommend a staging import step (dry-run) — otherwise risk of failed upgrades.

alex: cc @legal_john — pls prep the addendum. @jamie @sophie — can you two put a short POC runbook + cost bullets by EOD PST? I'll feed the customer. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: scheduled task created: "generate-airgap-poc-runbook" assigned to jamie,sophie due 6h

jamie: will do, uploading draft to the deal folder shortly.

legal_john: drafting addendum now, will share redline before EOD.
